title: Supply Network Disruption Benchmark
summary: Benchmark graph models on supplier, route, and dependency networks to predict disruption spillover across the supply chain.
knowledge_base: User: supply chain resilience teams benchmarking disruption models.
Primary pain: disruption spillover across dependency networks is hard to simulate and explain.
Decision output: alternate suppliers, expedited shipments, and contingency priorities.
Business impact: lower downtime and better resilience planning.
